invariants.rationale: Parallelism is typically required to be positive in distributed data processing to enable parallel execution.
The method expects a non-null list of records to deduplicate.
A HoodieIndex is necessary to determine record key grouping (global or not); null would cause errors.
schemaStr must be a valid string to be parsed into a HoodieSchema for later processing.
TypedProperties is required by downstream invocations (e.g., reduceRecords, DeleteContext) and must be non-null.
